skills.description: Use when Codex needs to help Xiepro or colleagues inspect, explain, validate, or prepare project-specific customer legacy data cleaning for BesChannels/Zhiqu Baichuan import, especially Excel/CSV migration files with province-city, email, mobile phone, job-title merge, dedupe keys, audit sheets, or import-ready CSV/XLSX outputs. Use for AI-guided Chinese confirmation before cleaning, reusable field-rule explanation, source-preserving historical data cleanup, and post-cleaning validation.
skills.description_zh:
面向致趣百川/BesChannels 历史客户数据迁移的 AI 辅助清洗技能，适合处理 Excel/CSV 客户导入文件。技能会先检查表头、行列数、重复字段和疑似清洗字段，用中文列出待确认项，再指导按省市、邮箱、手机号、去重键等规则进行保守清洗与结果校验。

核心原则是不覆盖源文件、不随意删除客户行、不弱猜地址；无法稳定判断的内容优先清空字段并进入审计。内置只读检查和校验脚本，可识别 GB18030/UTF-8 编码、乱码表头、关键列缺失、邮箱手机号格式异常、去重后行数变化等问题，帮助同事在导入前确认数据是否安全。
skills.name: xiepro-beschannels-legacy-clean
